text.jp:
2000年の時を越えて滅びをもたらし
復活をくりかえす、不滅のカオス。
text.official_en: That cause was Chaos—an immortal being from two thousand years ago who could transcend time itself.
text.real_en: Chaos, an immortal being who brought destruction across two thousand years, dying and returning again and again.

text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたと彼は、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and the Warrior of Light are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたと彼は、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and the Warrior of Light are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
あなたの想いの光で、クリスタルは輝き
やがて世界を照らす光となるでしょう。
text.official_en: Hold fast to that undying light—no matter how grim your prospects—and it shall one day illuminate the world.
text.real_en: Your feelings will make the Crystal shine, and one day that light will illuminate the world.

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
ここにいる理由も、これからの目的もわからず
誰もいない荒野で、冒険を始めるとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to suddenly find yourself in an unknown wasteland—with nary a friend, a destination, or even an explanation—what would you do?

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
すべての人に忘れられても、世界を救えるなら
悔いはない……英雄らしい答えです。
text.official_en: There is no denying the heroic nature of those words; one individual’s glory pales in comparison to the future of many.
text.real_en: Even if everyone forgot me, I would have no regrets if I could save the world... A truly heroic answer.

text.jp:
それでもきっと、新たな光の戦士が現れる……。
信じることで、希望の物語はつづくでしょう。
text.official_en: And yet, you firmly believe another will take up the gage in your stead. Indeed, the light of hope cannot be so easily extinguished.
text.real_en: Even so, another Warrior of Light will surely arise... As long as people believe, the story of hope can go on.

text.jp: それは、クリスタルの幻想が生まれた異界の記憶――
text.official_en: This world is unique, as it is where the crystalline legacy was formed.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world, where the legend of the Crystals began—

text.jp:
そんな不安を素直に認め、進んでいけば
導きの光が、あなたの道を照らすのです。
text.official_en: As long as you acknowledge that doubt and persevere, rather than rejecting it, your way shall be lit by a guiding light.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en:
Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero,
regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp: なぜ自分なのか不安になる
text.official_en: Feel anxious about being the chosen one.
text.real_en: Worry about why it had to be me.

text.jp:
まずは目の前の敵と戦い、次の目的地をめざす……
一歩一歩を重ねることで、物語が生まれるのです。
text.official_en: Focus on the enemy at hand, the destination in sight... With each step you take, a new page in the chronicle of your glorious journey will be penned.
text.real_en: Fight the enemy before you and head for your next destination... With every step you take, a story begins to unfold.

text.jp:
クリスタルの導きを信じ、迷わずに進む。
光の戦士は、まさに光のごとく歩みました。
text.official_en: It did much for the Warrior of Light as well. His faith in the Crystals never wavered, and his figure shone like a lodestar wherever he went.
text.real_en: He trusted the Crystals' guidance and pressed on without hesitation, moving forward like a ray of light.

text.jp:
世界が滅びかけた記憶など、消えたほうが
人々が幸せに暮らせるから……でしょうか？
text.official_en: Is this to say that “ignorance is bliss”? That humanity would be happier not knowing how close their world came to destruction?
text.real_en: Perhaps people would live happier lives if the memory of how close the world came to destruction were erased?

text.jp: 世界を救えるなら、かまわない
text.official_en: “That’s a small price to pay.”
text.real_en: If I can save the world, I don’t mind being forgotten.

text.jp:
倒しても倒しても、時をさかのぼり、
何度でもよみがえってしまう宿敵――
あなたなら、どう戦いますか？
text.official_en: Upon defeat, Chaos would travel back into the past and rise again. Were you to face such a foe, how would you triumph over them?

text.jp: 光の戦士はまた現れる
text.official_en: “There will be other Warriors of Light.”
text.real_en: Another Warrior of Light will appear.

text.jp:
困難に遭っても思い悩まず、淡々と前に進む。
黙して語らぬ背中に、意志の強さを感じます。
text.official_en: Steadfast determination can work miracles on the battlefield. It can uplift even the weariest allies’ spirits and lead them to victory.
text.real_en: When hardship comes, he presses on without dwelling on his troubles. His silent resolve speaks volumes.

text.jp:
地水火風をつかさどるクリスタルが
光を奪われ、滅びゆく世界。
text.official_en: It was also for a time shrouded in darkness—its four elemental Crystals bereft of light.
text.real_en: A world on the brink of ruin, where the Crystals of earth, water, fire and wind had been robbed of their light.

text.jp:
多くを語らない彼でしたが、あなたと同じく
深い思いやりがあったのかもしれませんね。
text.official_en: Perhaps the Warrior of Light held a similar belief, but none shall truly know, as he was a man of few words.
text.real_en: He was a man of few words, but perhaps he shared your deep compassion.

text.jp:
彼の想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
彼は2000年の時を越え、過去で待ちかまえる
カオスとの最終決戦に臨みます。
text.official_en: After journeying two thousand years into the past, the Warrior of Light was poised to settle the score with Chaos.

text.jp:
彼は、ウォーリアオブライト……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That individual was the Warrior of Light, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was the Warrior of Light... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
彼はクリスタルに導かれて旅をつづけ、
世界をおびやかす元凶を知ります。
text.official_en: As the Warrior of Light continued his journey, he eventually came to learn the true cause of the world’s plight.

text.jp:
彼は竜王の試練を乗り越え、新たな力を得て
生まれ変わるほどの成長を遂げました。
text.official_en: For the Warrior of Light, he weathered the Dragon King’s trial and was rewarded with such power, it was as if he had been born anew.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp: 忘れられたほうが幸せ
text.official_en: “It’s for the best anyway.”
text.real_en: Being forgotten would be for the best.

text.jp: 悩みすぎずに立ち向かう
text.official_en: By doing instead of worrying.

text.jp:
意味がわからなくても、戦わなければ
生き延びることはできません。
text.official_en: While you need not know <text style="italic">why</> you fight, there will come a time when you must fight in order to survive.
text.real_en: Even if you do not understand why, you must fight to survive.

text.jp:
戦いと災いの記憶が消えれば、いつかまた
同じ過ちがくりかえされるかもしれません。
text.official_en: With the pain wrought by calamity and conflict long forgotten, humanity could easily find itself repeating its past mistakes.

text.jp: 戦いながら意味をみつける
text.official_en: Fight on and find meaning along the way.

text.jp:
戦って世界を救っても、誰の記憶にも
記録にも残らず、忘れられてしまう――
あなたは、どう思いますか？
text.official_en: Though the world would be saved, both he and his deeds would be relegated to oblivion. Were you in his shoes, what would be the first thought to cross your mind?

text.jp:
暗黒に染まりし世界で探求の旅を始めたのは
いにしえの予言に伝わる、光の戦士でした。
text.official_en: However, a lone individual endeavored to lift this caliginous veil—a stalwart champion foretold of in an ancient prophecy.
text.real_en: In that world shrouded in darkness, a warrior foretold by an ancient prophecy set out on a journey of discovery.

text.jp: 楽しまなければ冒険じゃない
text.official_en: Simply enjoy the journey.

text.jp:
永遠に破滅をくりかえす、それが世界の宿命なら
災いの根源までたどり、宿命を断つしかありません。
text.official_en: If the world is destined to repeat the past, the only solution is to ensure the past cannot be repeated—by altering destiny itself.
text.real_en: If the world is fated to suffer the same destruction forever, you must find the source of the calamity and break that fate.

text.jp:
滅びゆく世界をめぐる、厳しい戦いの旅。
だからこそ前向きに楽しむ意志が光ります。
text.official_en: The life of a hero is often fraught with death and destruction. In dark times, a bright outlook can serve as a beacon for others.
text.real_en: A harsh journey of battles through a dying world... That makes the determination to enjoy it all the more remarkable.

text.jp: 災いの根を断つ方法を探す
text.official_en: By getting to the root of the problem.

text.jp:
異界の幻影　ウォーリアオブライト
すべてのはじまりを告げた光の戦士。
text.official_en:
The First Warrior of Light
The adventurer with whom it all began.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision: the Warrior of Light. The warrior who heralded the beginning of it all.

text.jp:
脅威を乗り越える方法を探すのは大事ですが
自分を高めることを忘れてはなりませんね。
text.official_en: While a strategic and analytical mind can be a boon to a combatant, the will to improve is of no less import.
text.real_en: It's important to look for a way to overcome a threat, but you mustn't forget to improve yourself.

text.jp:
自分が予言された戦士だと言われても
実感がなければ、不安になるものです。
text.official_en: As the aphorism states, “words are wind,” and without proof, it may be hard to believe those uttered long ago.
text.real_en: Even if someone tells you that you are the warrior of prophecy, it is only natural to feel anxious if you cannot believe it yourself.

text.jp: 自分が強く生まれ変わる
text.official_en: By becoming stronger than them.
text.real_en: Be reborn stronger.

text.jp:
記憶が消えても、気高い想いはきっと遺り
クリスタルのように、永遠に輝くでしょう。
text.official_en: Furthermore, even if your deeds were to be erased from memory, your ideals would surely remain etched in people’s minds.
text.real_en: Even if memories vanish, those noble feelings will surely endure, shining forever like the Crystals.

text.jp:
過去にさかのぼって運命を変え、未来を救う……。
それが彼の決断でした。
text.official_en: That is what the Warrior of Light chose to do; he traveled to the past and changed fate to save the future.

text.jp:
過去のカオスを倒せば、いまの歴史は変わり
これまでの冒険も「なかったこと」に……。
text.official_en: There was, however, cause for concern. Should he triumph over his foe, his journey would cease to have been.
